name: fiscaal identificatienummer (FIN)
note: The Wet Fiscaal Identificatienummer (S.B. 2020 no. 17, of 13 January 2020), read 2026-10-31: the FIN is a unique, personal identifying number the Belastingdienst gives the taxpayer (art. 2(1)), carrying no information about the taxpayer (art. 2(2)); the inspector gives it to the taxpayer at once (art. 4(1)), one per taxpayer, replacing every earlier vastnummer, stamnummer or import-export number (art. 4(2), (3)); it is used for tax purposes (art. 5(1)); a taxpayer is anyone liable to tax under any tax law (art. 1(1)(f)). S.B. 2024 no. 74 (law of 26 June 2024, in force the day after its publication on 10 July 2024), read 2026-10-31, struck the words '8 (acht) cijferige' from art. 2(1), its explanatory memorandum saying the Belastingdienst's Multi Tax System works with a ten-digit number and that the law should hold no length, so that a change in the number of digits needn't change the law; and replaced 'the inspecteur der Directe Belastingen' by the inspectors of the Belastingdienst. The length is the Belastingdienst's own, on its page 'Betalingskenmerk' (read 2026-10-31): the payment reference is made of the 'FIN: 10 cijfers (xxxxxxxxxx)', then the tax code, year and period. READINGS: the ten digits are read from the Belastingdienst's description of the payment reference, which states the FIN's part as ten digits, the law since 2024 holding no length; 'who' is read as anyone, the law giving the FIN to every taxpayer, natural or legal person, without condition of citizenship or residence; 'when' is read as on registration with the Belastingdienst (the inspector gives it at once to the taxpayer, and natural persons register through the online portal). No fee, time, age or check digit is stated.

sources.title: Belastingdienst Suriname, Betalingskenmerk
sources.said: Het betalingskenmerk bestaat uit: ... FIN: 10 cijfers (xxxxxxxxxx)

sources.title: Wet Fiscaal Identificatienummer, Staatsblad 2020 no. 17 (13 January 2020), as De Nationale Assemblée publishes it
sources.said: een ieder die ingevolge enige belastingwet belastingplichtig is. ... persoonsgebonden identificerend nummer, toegekend door de Belastingdienst aan de belastingplichtige. ... Het fiscaal identificatienummer bevat geen informatie over de belastingplichtige. ... De inspecteur verstrekt terstond een fiscaal identificatienummer aan de belastingplichtige. ... Het fiscaal identificatienummer zal gebruikt worden voor fiscale doeleinden.

sources.title: Wet van 26 juni 2024 houdende wijziging van de Wet Fiscaal Identificatienummer, Staatsblad 2024 no. 74, with its explanatory memorandum
sources.said: In artikel 2 lid 1 wordt de zinsnede "8 (acht) cijferige" geschrapt. ... Zij treedt in werking met ingang van de dag volgende op die van haar afkondiging. ... de Multi Tax System, kan werken met een 10 (tien) cijferige nummer.
